interpreter: current Python with pyomo, highspy 1.15.1, numpy
parameters: parameters --da DA --run SHORT_RUN --window W --output NEW_JSON --name NAME --domain current_sced_research
prepare: prepare --da DA --run SHORT_RUN --window W --parameters JSON --output NEW_DIR
hour: hour --da DA --execution JSON --quarters Q0 Q1 Q2 Q3 --output NEW_JSON
blocked: nonzero exit; error field; never repeat unknown native occurrence
read_scope: existing accepted PRICE or v26 hour is byte-verified read-only, no re-signing
hour_seed: hour0 requires explicit accepted same-DA initial seed PRICE; never filled from unrelated case or current-SCED dual
prepare_gate: only an actually accepted selected short pair; no optimizer during parameters/prepare/read/install
window_scope: 0..94, exact4h coverage. Last day/hour extension not yet supported
research_notice: all results DC research, NOT AC safety certificate or formal bill
install: copy INSTALL_MANIFEST relative paths under common engine root; current interpreter, no hardcoded cloud path
